maudhui: (1) Subject to this Constitution and to any law enacted by Parliament for that purpose, the President may declare the existence of a state of war between the United Republic and any other country. (2) After making such declaration, the President shall transmit a copy of the declaration to the Speaker of the National Assembly who, after consultation with the Leader of Government Business in the National Assembly, shall within fourteen days from the date of the declaration convene a meeting of the National Assembly to consider the situation and to decide whether or not to pass a resolution supporting the declaration of war made by the President.
